title: Work in the background
summary: What the app does on the author's behalf carries on while they're elsewhere.
description: Answers, recordings and reading take minutes. The author starts them and puts the phone away; they carry on until they're done, and the phone says so while they do.

stories.want: to start an answer or a recording and then leave the app or turn off the screen
stories.soThat: I don't have to watch it to have it finish

requirements.text: Work the app does by itself on the author's behalf (the assistant answering, a recording being written and spoken, an item's details being read, a paper being fetched from arXiv) carries on when the author leaves the app or the screen turns off, until it's done or fails; only closing the app stops it.
On Android, while such work runs, the app runs it in the foreground, and a notification says what it's doing; tapping it opens the app, and it goes when the work is done.
On a computer, while such work runs, the computer doesn't go to sleep for being left alone.

A request that fails for the network (no connection, a dropped one, a timeout, or the service busy) is tried again, waiting longer each time, for up to `work.network-patience`, before the work fails; the failure says what the network said.

values.description: How long work keeps trying a request through a network that fails.
